# copyright status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:copyrightStatus`](gmeow-copyrightStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/copyrightStatus>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The copyright status of a work — one of the [`gmeow:CopyrightStatus`](../classes/gmeow-CopyrightStatus.md) values (in-copyright / public-domain / no-known-copyright / not-evaluated), aligned to RightsStatements.org and PREMIS. Functional.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Copyright`](../classes/gmeow-Copyright.md) -> [`gmeow:CopyrightStatus`](../classes/gmeow-CopyrightStatus.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:copyrightStatus`](gmeow-copyrightStatus.md) from [`gmeow:Copyright`](../classes/gmeow-Copyright.md) to [`gmeow:CopyrightStatus`](../classes/gmeow-CopyrightStatus.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to classify a work's copyright standing against the RightsStatements.org / PREMIS vocabulary — in-copyright, public-domain, no-known-copyright, not-evaluated, or a finer statement.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for trademark or licence status (those are [`gmeow:trademarkStatus`](gmeow-trademarkStatus.md) / [`gmeow:licenseFamily`](gmeow-licenseFamily.md)) and avoid a free-text status; reference a [`gmeow:CopyrightStatus`](../classes/gmeow-CopyrightStatus.md) value.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:copyrightStatus`](gmeow-copyrightStatus.md) once per [`Copyright`](../classes/gmeow-Copyright.md) (functional) to a [`gmeow:CopyrightStatus`](../classes/gmeow-CopyrightStatus.md) individual aligned to RightsStatements.org; for a lapsed status keep the record and add [`gmeow:validUntil`](gmeow-validUntil.md) rather than deleting it.

### Examples

- ex:reportCopyright [`gmeow:copyrightStatus`](gmeow-copyrightStatus.md) [`gmeow:copyrightStatusInCopyright`](../individuals/gmeow-copyrightStatusInCopyright.md).
